sections.title: Tide data
sections.text: EOT20 tide model: Hart-Davis, M. G., Piccioni, G., Dettmering, D., Schwatke, C., Passaro, M., Seitz, F. (2021). EOT20 - A global Empirical Ocean Tide model from multi-mission satellite altimetry. SEANOE. https://doi.org/10.17882/79489. CC BY 4.0. The game uses the tide constituents of EOT20 at Vũng Tàu, computed with pyTMD.

sections.title: Sea floor
sections.text: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2017–2024. GEBCO Compilation Group (2025) GEBCO 2025 Grid (doi:10.5285/37c52e96-24ea-67ce-e063-7086abc05f29). The heights of the intertidal zone use the method of DEA Intertidal (Geoscience Australia).
